name: Axel
source: Rambunctious and happy, Axel is always the light of the party wherever he goes. With his outgoing and friendly nature, he never failed to make a friend. Sometimes, even out of the worst of people. However, that is not a reason to underestimate him. A mistake proven to be fatal by many.
